sources.observed_facts: Router detects completed candidates, runs deterministic preflight, selects exactly one configured tool and passes target/source branches.
After tool-driven auto archive the workflow proceeds to diff detection and conditional validation/consolidation, without invoking the available completion assertion.
Standalone action lists active changes, reports remaining completed names/status/task counts and exits failure, but no caller was found in inspected monthly workflows.
Diff detector only checks git diff under openspec; it does not verify no completed active candidates remain.
Prompt asks for post-archive active-list confirmation; this delegates the check to the AI rather than enforcing it after a successful tool exit.
Validation, generated-path guard and conditional commit/push/PR handling are implemented.
